scope: Post-result integration audit, declared before executing these additional checks. The original spectral and graph results are already known.
immutable_physics: Original action, profile, g=.1, MSbar mu0=gv and pole input; no finite counterterm fitting.

independent_discretization.method: Dirichlet finite-difference block determinant with independent matrix inverses for Born coefficients

enclosure: Cubic-spline cell Bernstein ranges, padded by 1e-10, bound each local Hessian interval on 0<=r<=R. Verify rounded-up Vmax=2, I2=1800 and Irad3=600; these enclose the supplied spline, not an interval-certified exact boundary-value solution.
tails: Bound the omitted ell>40 for 0<zeta<10 with the compact-support massless Green bound, and zeta>10 at all ell with the resolvent Hilbert-Schmidt bound. No fitted extrapolation.
numerical_allowance: If complete replay differs by less than .02 energy units gv, use .02 as an explicitly empirical numerical allowance, plus the analytical cutoff-tail bounds. This is not a certified interval for the exact continuum saddle or a bound on higher loops.
graph_support_check: Recompute matched graphs on R20 and R25 and compare to original R50; record actual differences. Domain/origin/ODE/IR tests are numerical evidence, not exact profile error enclosures.
rejection: A failed normalization, non-negligible determinant phase, failed finite-difference check, missing replay points, failed profile bound or large unexplained replay change blocks the numerical binding verdict. Do not replace the failure with parameter tuning.
binding: Nearest integer charge N from binding_protocol.json; only the N free-X-carrier channel is decided. No fission/lifetime/all-order or empirical claim.
